data.name: Jasveeran
data.gender_notes: Jasveeran is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: The name Jasveeran is derived from the Sanskrit words ‘Jasu’ meaning victory or prosperity and ‘Veera’ meaning hero. It is a name that signifies strength, power, and victory in life. The name Jasveeran carries the meaning “Lord of the Universe” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Hindu tradition and is also used in Sanskrit, Punjabi. Parents who choose Jasveeran usually hope their child will grow to embody lord of the universe and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: The name Jasveeran signifies the divine power that resides within each individual, enabling them to overcome obstacles and achieve their goals. It is a name that inspires courage, determination, and perseverance.
data.etymology: Jasveeran belongs to the Hindu linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Lord of the Universe.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Jasveeran total 5, giving a life-path number of 5. Number 5 is linked with Mercury and with the qualities of freedom, adaptability and curiosity.
